summary: Shamans are hybrid casters and melee fighters who call on totems, shocks and the elements to damage enemies, enhance their weapons and heal allies. They wear mail armour and now include Dwarves, so the Alliance can play them.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Water Shield (20) and Riptide (40) show the same levels. Stormstrike differs, see conflicts.

changes: Dwarves can be Shamans, so the Alliance has the class.
Fire Nova now explodes around your active Fire Totem instead of being its own totem.

New spells: Call of the Elements (20), Call of the Ancestors (30) and Call of the Spirits (40) place up to four totems from the Totem Bar; Totemic Call (22) moves your totems to you and Totemic Recall (20) dismisses them for a partial mana refund.
Grace of Air Totem can be combined directly with Windfury Totem or Flametongue Totem.
New talent abilities: Water Shield (Restoration), Riptide (Restoration capstone) and Rage of the Farseer (Enhancement capstone).
Stormstrike moves to row 4 of Enhancement with a shorter cooldown; Mana Tide Totem moves to row 4 of Restoration; Lightning Mastery is reworked.

New passive talents include Lightning Overload, Earthbound (turns Earthbind Totem into an on-demand root), Maelstrom Weapon, Mental Dexterity, Mental Quickness, Shamanistic Focus, Improved Stormstrike and Mindfulness.
conflicts: The Wowhead Forever tooltip of Stormstrike says level 40, but wowforevertalent.com puts it at row 4 (level 25) and lists the spellbook level as 25; the table uses the talent row.
wowforevertalent.com lists Totemic Call under Enhancement and the other new totem spells under Elemental; tabs follow that site.
The Warcraft Tavern guide gives the same ID (16086) for Improved Fire Nova and Trial by Fire, and two IDs (30165, 30160) for Elemental Devastation; these are passive talents and not used.
gaps: Shamans have no permanent pet; no pet abilities to list.
Every rank after the first and the level it is trained at.
Passive talents (Lightning Overload, Earthbound, Maelstrom Weapon and others) are not listed individually.
